universe.pit_hazard: rolling 24h snapshot. For a replayed cross-section, rebuild the table from klines as of the decision bar.

contract_meta.pit_hazard: Listing REGISTRY, current only. A symbol's row appears when it is listed and disappears when it is delisted, and the venue re-tags sectors without notice — so replaying today's table at an earlier decision time both invents metadata for coins that did not exist yet and hides the tags a delisted one had. Capture it forward alongside the universe it will be joined to.

open_interest_snapshot.pit_hazard: Point read of a live inventory, all-market snapshot only: the endpoint has no history at all, and the mark price that converts it to dollars is today's. Replaying it at an earlier decision time states this week's positioning as last month's. Capture it forward alongside the universe it will be joined to; for a replayable series use `open_interest` (~30d) instead.

oi_change_snapshot.pit_hazard: Two hazards, not one. The public endpoint keeps only ~30 days, so a longer lookback silently starts mid-series. And the ROSTER is point-in-time: it was chosen from the universe as it looked at capture, so replaying this frame against a different decision time screens a set of instruments that was picked using the future.

long_short_ratio_snapshot.pit_hazard: One reading per instrument with no history kept, and a point-in-time ROSTER — see `oi_change_snapshot`. For the ratio's own history on one instrument use `long_short_ratio` (~30d).
